result.summary: Found 1 issue: a restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of an actual photo. Horizontally clipped carousel items and bottom-cut content were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' displays a generic gray broken-image placeholder icon rather than the restaurant's photo, leaving a large empty gray area at the top of the card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image loads correctly; add a retry/fallback image or hide the image area gracefully when the asset fails to load.
